series_summary: Alexander and Juliana are married but declared invalid by the High Priest due to lack of royal license. Alexander secures a ten-day ecclesiastical trial to prove their marriage's validity. Catherine, humiliated and exiled to scullery maid duty, secretly allies with Father Thomas to sabotage the hearing and destroy Alexander from within. Juliana stands as Duchess-in-waiting while Catherine plots her revenge.
